THE DECISION: A vs B.

Both keep the three existing chips untouched. The difference is whether the count is visible or hidden for someone who only ever wants once a day.

A: one quiet row, always there, reading "مرة في اليوم". Discoverable, costs one line of height.
B: nothing at all until you tap "أكثر من مرة في اليوم". Zero cost, but nobody finds it.

My pick: A. The row also teaches what the default is.

These three are shared by whichever of A or B wins.

The square fills proportionally instead of gaining a fourth colour, so a once-a-day habit is byte-for-byte what it is today: one tap, empty to full.

Rooms already freeze their rule, so changing a linked habit's count trips the existing "settings differ" notice rather than silently regrading finished days.
